summary: A member with [trim] local = true trims its own due cut each day: observer.observed and resource.observed, by their audited retention rules, with no seal, verification or copy-proof. Off by default

schema.detail: No table or claim schema change. Local cuts use the existing checkpoints, checkpoint_* and retired_* tables.

rules.detail: Local trim drops only LOCAL_TRIM_KINDS (observer.observed, resource.observed) by their existing audited rules; every other kind is kept. Shared checkpoint rules and their digest are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire or stored format change. Deleted identities travel through the retired ledger as before.

downtime.detail: None. A cut runs in the background, in chunks, on the existing trim pacing.

manual.detail: No manual step. A stopped local trim alerts and is resumed with st replication checkpoint resume --reason TEXT, which an agent may run on such a member.

recovery.detail: Remove the setting and restart: the member stops trimming locally. What it deleted stays retired.
